_comment: The one place the site Content-Security-Policy is written down (HFY-TSK-149, review PS-11, BRD 'no third-party calls from family pages'). infrastructure/cloudformation/app-stack.yaml (SiteCspPolicy, SiteCspReportOnlyPolicy) and scripts/cloudfront/join-csp.js (JOIN_CSP) must hold these exact strings; scripts/cloudfront/test/site-csp.test.mjs and scripts/infra/test/test_app_stack.py pin them. The policy covers HTML pages (the default cache behavior); the /uploads/* sandbox CSP and the gated data behaviors are separate and unchanged. script-src and style-src allow 'unsafe-inline' because every page carries the inline shell-hint head script and the feature-flag block; img-src and connect-src are what enforce 'no third party'. worker-src 'self' (viz-v3-csp-worker, HFY-TSK-310) is for MapLibre's same-origin module worker; blob: is deliberately not allowed. connect-src names exactly one third-party origin besides 'self' (HFY-TSK-407): the presigned-upload host of the site bucket, https://<upload-bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com (virtual-hosted style, the AWS SDK v3 default, in the region of hfy-api and of the bucket), because the browser PUTs member photos straight to S3 with the URL from POST /api/uploads (islands/src/lib/upload.js). 'base' holds that origin as the literal CloudFormation expression ${MediaBucket}.s3.${AWS::Region}: the template carries 'base' as a !Sub string, and the tests resolve the two names (the stack parameter MediaBucket, the stack region) before they compare or run it. 'join' has no such origin: nothing on /join/ uploads.
base: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://${MediaBucket}.s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com; worker-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
join: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; worker-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-ancestors 'none'
